country.evidence_source: [/page/12/Text/2] participants were recruited using the following inclusion criteria: they were currently employed in a full time job, were at least 20 years old, and lived with a spouse or a partner in South Korea.

Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/11/Text/11] ...single-item scale could be used as a proxy of life satisfaction and family relationship satisfaction. [/page/12/Text/3] Multiple-item life satisfaction was measured with the five-item scale by Diener, Emmons, Larsen, and Griffin (1985); Multiple-item family relationship satisfaction was measured with a modified version of the six-item Quality Marriage Index (QMI) by Norton (1983).

sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/12/Text/2] 246 employees were recruited via a commercial panel provider (Embrain, http://www. embrain.com/eng).

ethnicity.evidence_source: [/page/12/Text/2] Respondents were diverse in terms of sex (53% men), age (M = 39.31, SD = 8.46), position in the organization (15.68% staff/associates, 22.88% assistant managers, 28.39% manager, and 33.05% senior managers), most were dual-earner couples (76.02%), with varied educational attainment (8.54% with a high school degree, 18.29% with a junior college degree, 58.13% with a bachelor degree, and 15.04% with a master or doctoral degree).

lag.evidence_source: [/page/12/Text/2] Respondents completed the survey through an online link with one-week time lag between each response and were compensated with KRW 2000 (approximately USD 2.00) for each survey completion.
